잘못하다.translation: I did wrong; I am sorry.
I made a mistake in the calculation, so I came up short on money.

싫어지다.translation: Eating the same food every day, I got sick of it.
There is so much homework that I have come to dislike studying.

뚱뚱하다.translation: Our cat is a little chubby.
That chubby puppy is sleeping on the sofa.

작아지다.translation: The clothes have gotten too small, so I can't wear them.
As I go farther away, the house looks smaller.

익숙해지다.translation: I have gotten used to my new job now.
I will slowly get used to spicy food.

가까워지다.translation: Working together, I became closer with my friend.
The exam is getting close, so I feel nervous.

잘못되다.translation: The calculation was wrong, so I did it again.

제발.translation: Please, I'm begging you, be quiet.

문자.translation: I sent my friend a text message.

일기.translation: I write in my diary every night.

용서.translation: I asked my friend for forgiveness.

부담.translation: Please don't feel too much pressure.

흑인.translation: A Black family moved in next door.

흑인.text: 저는 그 흑인 가수의 노래를 자주 들어요.
흑인.translation: I often listen to that Black singer's songs.

체계.text: 이 회사는 일하는 체계가 잘 잡혀 있어요.
체계.translation: This company has a well-established system for how work is done.

백인.text: 우리 학교에는 백인 선생님이 한 분 계세요.
백인.translation: There is one white teacher at our school.

백인.text: 저 백인 아저씨는 한국말을 아주 잘해요.
백인.translation: That white man speaks Korean very well.

붓다.translation: Please pour some water into the cup.

이스라엘.translation: Israel is a country next to the Mediterranean Sea.

이스라엘.text: 친구가 다음 달에 이스라엘로 여행을 가요.
이스라엘.translation: My friend is going on a trip to Israel next month.

유일.text: 이 동네의 유일한 빵집이 문을 닫았어요.
유일.translation: The only bakery in this neighborhood has closed.

으로써.text: 이 방법으로써 문제를 풀 수 있어요.
으로써.translation: You can solve the problem by this method.

건배.translation: Let's make a toast to the new year!

향수.text: 이 향수는 꽃 냄새가 나서 좋아요.
향수.translation: I like this perfume because it smells like flowers.

사모.translation: I went to my teacher's house and greeted his wife.
My teacher's wife gave us kimchi she made herself.

안되다.translation: Work just isn't going well today.

부처.translation: My uncle works at a government ministry.

부처.text: 이 일은 여러 부처가 함께 맡고 있어요.
부처.translation: Several ministries are handling this task together.

충분.text: 시간이 충분해서 천천히 갈 수 있어요.
충분.translation: We have enough time, so we can go slowly.
To stay healthy, you need to get enough sleep.

내버리다.text: 다 쓴 건전지를 아무 데나 내버리면 안 돼요.
내버리다.translation: You must not throw used batteries away just anywhere.

발포.text: 발포 비타민을 물에 넣으면 거품이 올라와요.
발포.translation: When you put an effervescent vitamin tablet in water, bubbles rise up.

발포.text: 욕조에 발포 입욕제를 넣었더니 향기가 좋았어요.
발포.translation: I put a fizzing bath bomb in the tub, and it smelled lovely.

현관.translation: There are a lot of shoes in the entryway.

무스.translation: I put mousse in my hair and headed out.

무스.text: 무스를 너무 많이 바르면 머리가 딱딱해져요.
무스.translation: If you put on too much mousse, your hair gets stiff.

신성.translation: A new nova was discovered in the night sky.

신성.text: 신성은 갑자기 아주 밝게 빛나는 별이에요.
신성.translation: A nova is a star that suddenly shines very brightly.

발달.translation: Life has become more convenient thanks to the development of the internet.

발달.text: 아이의 언어 발달에는 책 읽기가 도움이 돼요.
발달.translation: Reading books helps a child's language development.

매트.translation: I spread a mat on the floor and exercised.

대기실.translation: Please wait in the waiting room for a moment.
There are a lot of people in the hospital waiting room.

미처.text: 너무 급해서 미처 우산을 챙기지 못했어요.
미처.translation: I was in such a hurry that I didn't manage to take an umbrella.

미처.text: 그 일이 그렇게 어려운 줄은 미처 몰랐어요.
미처.translation: I hadn't realized at all that the task was that difficult.

수없이.text: 어릴 때 수없이 넘어지면서 자전거를 배웠어요.
수없이.translation: I learned to ride a bike as a kid by falling countless times.

수없이.text: 밤하늘에 별이 수없이 많이 떠 있어요.
수없이.translation: There are countless stars in the night sky.

조화.text: 이 옷은 색깔이 서로 조화를 이루어서 예뻐요.
조화.translation: These clothes look nice because the colors go well together.

부츠.translation: It's winter, so I bought new boots.
It was snowing, so I went out wearing boots.

소비.text: 요즘은 물가가 올라서 소비를 줄이고 있어요.
소비.translation: Prices have gone up lately, so I'm cutting back on spending.
I write down my monthly spending in a household account book.

해산.translation: Let's break up today's gathering here.
The company dinner broke up around ten o'clock.

스카프.translation: It's warm with a scarf around my neck.
Where did you buy this scarf?

만찬.translation: We had a family dinner at a hotel yesterday.
I prepared a feast for our guests.

골반.translation: I've been sitting for a long time, so my pelvis hurts.
Yoga makes your pelvis more flexible.

속보.translation: Breaking news about the typhoon is on TV.
I was startled when I saw the breaking news.

연구원.translation: I work as a researcher at a university.
The newly arrived researcher helped with the experiment.

예능.translation: I often watch variety shows on weekends.

예능.text: 그 가수는 요즘 예능에도 자주 나와요.
예능.translation: That singer often appears on variety shows these days too.
